title: The Derby at the Mineola Nature Preserve
specs: Equestrian trails shared with walkers, joggers, and non-motorized bikes
Trails designed to be maintained for generations with user fees funding maintenance
Proof of Negative Coggins required as per Texas law
Horses and riders must remain within designated areas while loading and unloading
Youth groups, organized parties, and other outdoor activities encouraged to reserve Pavilion

blurb: Guests can use equestrian trails shared with walkers, joggers, and non-motorized bikes. The Derby Pavilion offers restrooms, showers, and RV utility connections. The preserve is managed by the City of Mineola with user fees funding maintenance and improvements.
extraNote: Trails open subject to conditions; call 903-569-6183 to confirm · If trails are closed due to weather or maintenance, please honor temporary signs · Failure to observe guidelines may cause removal and possible fine · Derby Pavilion rental requires $100 deposit · Equestrian Trail Head about one fourth mile from entrance, turn right on first road to the right; signs at top of hill note horse trailer parking; Pavilion (The Derby) has restrooms and showers.
